status: Installed in both local addons; 16 installation smoke suites and desktop timing pass. Development preview, not full release qualification.
findings: Opening beforetoggle is synchronous and cancelable; cancellation preserves the existing menu and focus.
Closing beforetoggle is synchronous and noncancelable.
Handler removal of the popover attribute or element aborts opening before sibling dismissal.
native_gap: Current native popover_show changes state and focus immediately and queues only toggle. There is no beforetoggle event or synchronous veto path.
remaining: Investigate the recorded 1080p frame-budget failure, finish current lifecycle and 4K qualification, and address broader game-UI requirements. No lower-end hardware qualification is established. Browser task timing and nested synchronous dispatch remain documented differences.

core.scope: 24 mode/action combinations cover cancellation, non-bubbling handler lookup, focus and sibling preservation, target removal, attribute removal, document reload, duplicate/reentrant requests, and layout update during veto. Opening applies when the host resumes event polling. Legacy immediate methods remain unchanged.
core.queue_pressure: 256 accepted requests survive a full queue; the 257th is rejected explicitly, ordinary toggle notification pressure does not discard requests, and all accepted requests can be vetoed.

native_explicit_show.scope: Explicit show_popover drains opening requests before return. Markup handler and element_before_toggled signal may veto. Covers allow, cancel, signal cancellation, nested updates, removal, reload and duplicate reentrant show in auto/hint/manual modes.

opening_routes.scope: Godot enables queued popovertarget openings and routes explicit show/toggle openings through requests. Button requests retain the invoker to preserve detached submenu ancestry. Legacy C hosts retain immediate activation unless they opt in. Native tests cover show, toggle and keyboard button activation in auto/hint/manual modes.

closing_routes.scope: Explicit hide, toggle close and keyboard button close dispatch non-cancellable beforetoggle while open. Native tests cover nested update, removal, reload and duplicate hide/show from closing handlers across auto/hint/manual modes. Browser probe confirms close-remove and close-reopen final state; full queued toggle timing is not certified.

automatic_dismissal.scope: Escape, routed outside pointer release and host transient dismissal queue non-cancellable closing requests. Core regression requests dismissal twice before draining, verifies child-before-parent events while each is open, and preserves manual popovers. One-pass traversal avoids looping on pending closes.

parent_closure.scope: Requested parent closure queues non-manual descendants before the parent event, in reverse opening order. Native baseline reproduces wrong event order for auto/hint, corrected candidate passes. Manual children remain independent. Browser probe confirms DOM parent removal emits no beforetoggle.

sibling_replacement.scope: Allowed replacement defers opening until existing child/parent closing handlers complete, then revalidates the target and invoker. Closing during replacement suppresses focus restoration. Veto leaves existing menus open. Native baseline reproduces two missing closing-order failures; new candidate passes.

attribute_closure.scope: Document-owned scheduling hook queues closes after popover attribute changes without invoking game code inside DOM mutation. Handlers observe changed/removed attribute and live open state; children close before parent. Same computed mode does not close. Standalone DOM retains immediate fallback. Open-state getter now follows stored state until close completes, including attribute removal.

sanitizers.status: passed for attribute-state candidate before the subsequent replacement-mode fix
sanitizers.scope: Core snapshot compiled before mode revalidation; this result does not qualify the latest candidate.

pointer_opening.scope: Mouse activation matches Chrome beforetoggle snapshots of open menus/focus and final state. Outside clicks dismiss an existing auto/hint menu before a new opening veto; manual menus remain independent.

replacement_mutation.scope: Capture computed popover mode at opening event delivery and preserve it through replacement continuation. Changing the target mode from a closing handler aborts opening, matching Chrome final state. Target removal is also covered. Browser synchronous exception propagation is not provided by the queued C API.

atomic_parent_close.scope: With 255 protected opening requests queued, a parent-plus-child close is rejected before either closing event is accepted. Previously the child closed despite the parent request failing. Preflight counts unqueued descendants and protected events; ordinary notifications remain evictable.

saturated_replacement.scope: Accepted replacement progresses when its beforetoggle handler fills all 256 public queue slots. One prioritized closing event plus one internal continuation use at most two extra queue entries. Captured old-stack references survive replacement removal/mode changes; the old stack finishes closing before target eligibility is rechecked. Capacity arithmetic rejects new protected requests without unsigned underflow while internal slots are occupied.

retained_plan_lifecycle.scope: Remove replacement, change replacement mode, remove old parent, reload document, destroy document, or allow completion while a child closing event and retained replacement continuation are active. Event draining is bounded and replacement DOM stays unaffected.

rendered_host.scope: Native behavior scene completes under OpenGL and Vulkan; this does not certify pixel parity or frame timing.

timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

OpenGL run 2 settings_slider changed whole-frame p95 is 17.187 ms (limit 16.667), while changed API p95 is 0.253 ms and changed core p95 is 0.2121 ms. UI-disabled and idle runs also contain long individual frame intervals, but this does not establish causation. Original failure retained.

lifecycle_verification.scope: Five-minute Unicode lifecycle observation on the patched Windows release runtime. Whole-process memory; not a timing-budget pass or hours-long leak proof.

presentation_diagnostic.conclusion: Slider changed-frame p95 ranged 14.822–15.952 ms. Onscreen and offscreen values overlap; no position-dependent cause established. Original 17.187 ms qualification failure remains unresolved and unchanged.
